description: ktor-kronos-native — JetBrains Ktor on Kotlin/Native with the kron engine (ktor-server-kron, in the MDA2AV/ktor fork) instead of CIO: one native binary, no JVM; the ktor-kronos entry runs the same routes on the JVM. kron is the Kotlin port of the ioxide io_uring runtime: one reactor per core, each pinned to its CPU and owning its ring and its share of the SO_REUSEPORT listeners; multishot accept and recv into provided buffer rings, driven from Kotlin over the kernel's own io_uring header (no liburing). Requests are parsed by Glyph11, the hardened HTTP/1.1 parser, and run through Ktor's own pipeline - routing, plugins, call.receive and call.respond - on the reactor that accepted the connection, with no thread pool in between. Responses to pipelined requests leave in one send. delay() is an IORING_OP_TIMEOUT on the reactor's ring. The routes are the ktor entry's, answered the same way: JSON through Ktor's ContentNegotiation with kotlinx.serialization, and Ktor's own WebSockets; json-comp is left out, as Ktor's Compression plugin is JVM-only. TLS on :8081 is the engine's own connector on kron's BoringSSL. The engine passes Ktor's own engine suites (HttpServerCommonTestSuite, WebSocketEngineSuite).
